en.title: Precision-Parameterized Candid Shot
en.summary: Single-shot fully quantified candid prompt: camera height/lens/framing/foreground/palette/lighting all parameterized and bound exactly from a shot spec
en.usage: Use with the consumer-side renderer and shot specs (JSON); optional clauses bind to empty string to omit the whole clause

zh-CN.title: 精调参数化抓拍镜头
zh-CN.summary: 单镜头全量化精调抓拍 Prompt：机位高度/焦段/占幅比/前景遮挡/色块百分比/双光源全部参数化，由 shot spec 精确绑定
zh-CN.usage: 配合消费侧渲染器按 shot spec（JSON）绑定变量；可选子句绑定为空字符串即整段省略
